requirements: Eventual documented Carbone feature coverage without claiming existing parity

decisions.reason: Supported runtime release line and explicit type-checked contracts

decisions.choice: Fastify 5 with application-owned JSON Schema; TypeBox and OpenAPI remain optional later additions
decisions.reason: Published LTS policy and official TypeBox provider; application-owned schemas only
EXIF orientation, resizing and image normalization; independent package adapter embeds bytes

decisions.choice: Independent TypeScript compiler and renderer; DOCX first, then format adapters
decisions.reason: User prefers ownership of core logic. Study the public Docxtemplater pipeline and OOXML standards, specify behavior, and implement new code. Docxtemplater is a development reference rather than a production dependency. This adds document-fidelity maintenance responsibility.

decisions.area: Document intake and other format adapters
decisions.reason: Enforce application-owned entry count and decompressed byte limits before processing; namespace-aware XML inspection with source-span edits for document content and targeted DOM edits for relationships. Preserve untouched package parts. PizZip is no longer needed.

decisions.choice: Private Gotenberg 8 container behind a converter interface
decisions.reason: Office/HTML/Markdown to PDF and common PDF manipulation through HTTP; inspect bundled converter versions before locking image digest

decisions.choice: Evaluate @cantoo/pdf-lib behind a small PDF-form adapter
decisions.reason: Maintained fork candidate; adoption conditional on released-package and form-fixture verification
PNG/SVG barcode rendering with a broad catalog
Server rendering without a browser; accepts our validated chart model; native editable Office charts remain separate work

decisions.choice: Standalone: SQLite via better-sqlite3 13.0.3. Future service deployment: PostgreSQL with Kysely/node-postgres.
decisions.reason: One-image installation with atomic state and document-byte commits. Keep the standalone adapter isolated; no experimental Node SQLite API dependency.

decisions.choice: Standalone: transactionally claimed SQLite jobs with expiring leases. Future PostgreSQL deployment: pg-boss behind a queue adapter.
decisions.reason: No extra service for PMS installation; bounded retries, leases, pinned template versions and idempotent submissions.

decisions.choice: Standalone: bounded SQLite BLOBs on a persistent local volume. Future service deployment: S3-compatible object storage.
decisions.reason: Atomic bytes and metadata simplify backup and recovery for a single instance; separate object storage when scaling beyond that deployment.
Separate browser admin UI; not required for first headless API milestone

decisions.choice: Node.js built-in test runner, fixture corpus and rendered-document visual regression
decisions.reason: Validate actual documents and relationships, not just mocked library calls

deployment: Standalone mode: one image with API, bounded workers, SQLite and loopback-only Gotenberg; one persistent local volume
worker: same TypeScript codebase, separate bounded render process
object storage: template and report bytes
